name: Universal Android Debloater NG
description:
Universal Android Debloater Next Generation (UAD-NG) is an open-source desktop tool to debloat non-rooted Android devices. Using ADB, it safely uninstalls or disables manufacturer and carrier bloatware to improve privacy and battery life.

Features:
- Extensively documented debloat package list with safety ratings and descriptions
- One-click disabling and re-enabling of carrier bloat, tracking daemons, and vendor apps
- Multi-user and multi-profile support (Work profiles, Secure Folder)
- Safe restoration and un-debloat functionality to restore original system state
- Connects directly over USB or Wi-Fi ADB without needing root access on the device
